sections.overview:
The seoauditor skill automates SEO audit processes to help identify and address technical and on-page optimization issues. Built by boshify, this marketing automation tool systematizes SEO analysis work that would otherwise require manual review. It's designed to streamline audit workflows and support continuous monitoring of SEO performance factors.
Automated technical SEO audits for website health checks
On-page optimization analysis across multiple pages
Regular SEO monitoring and issue identification
Pre-launch website SEO validation
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/boshify/seoauditor`
sections.usage:
```
Conduct a comprehensive SEO audit for [COMPANY], a [INDUSTRY] business. Analyze their website [URL] and provide actionable insights based on the following criteria: technical SEO, on-page SEO, off-page SEO, and content quality. Include specific recommendations for improvement.
```
Copy

